title: DEFINE step 3 PR 7: probe-runner seam (no shipped runner)
description: src/define/probe-runner.js is a seam only: it exports the ProbeRunner typedef, a NO_PROBE_RUNNER sentinel and an isProbeRunner guard. No runner ships. rcf-lite has no LLM at runtime and does not spawn processes or make network calls; the harness is the runner through `rcf define ledger probes add` or a test harness that passes a stub into computeReadiness. Keeps the extension point named rather than monkey-patched (ADR-4131 extended).
